description: k8s finalize-result 400 loop from empty tracker files: ml prune leaves zero-byte .mulch/expertise/*.jsonl, collectMulchDelta ships them verbatim (mergedBody: ''), validateArtifactDelta's reqString rejects '', the pod retries 5x and exits 75, and the run reaps finalize_unposted with its PUSHED branch stranded on origin. Salvage (warren-cd3b) never fires because the push succeeded. Diagnosis path: pod log tail shows 'result POST attempt n/5 got HTTP 400' + 'pushed=true'; server log shows the ValidationError stack at finalize-wire.ts validateArtifactDelta.
resolution: Validator accepts empty mergedBody via reqStringAllowEmpty (PR #984); stranded work recovered by opening the PR manually from the surviving warren/run_<id> branch (PR #983).

description: commitsAhead used plain rev-list <base>..HEAD, so a follow-up run that merged upstream into its PR branch reported every merged-in upstream commit (run_gevytzavaht0: 3278 for a 3-commit fix).
resolution: Added --first-parent to the rev-list count in both local and k8s finalizers (warren-a8cc, PR #1189). Test fakes match on args[0], so only exact-args assertions needed updating.
